chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Taymili narrated to us from his book in Rajab of the year 277 AH. He said: Muhammad ibn 'Uar ibn Yazid, the seller of Sabrī, and Muhammad ibn al-Walid ibn Khalid al-Khazzaz both narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Uthman narrated to us from Abdullah ibn Sinan. He said: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Abi Bilad narrated to me. He said: My father narrated to me from his father, from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata that he heard Imam Ali (peace be upon him) say:

Indeed, before the appearance of the Qa'im, there will be deceitful years, in which the truthful will be called liars, and the liars will be believed, and those who deceive will be brought closer, and the 'ruwaybida' will speak.

So I asked: 'What is the ruwaybida and what is the mahil?' He said: 'Do you not read the Quran? Its saying: And those who deceive will be brought closer.' He said: 'It refers to deceit.' I asked: 'And what is the mahil?' He said: 'It refers to the deceiver.'

key_terms.الرُّوَيْبِضَةُ: A simple, foolish, or insignificant person who speaks with authority
key_terms.الْقَائِم: The Qa'im (The Riser), referring to Imam Al-Mahdi (peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْمَاحِلُ: The master of deceit or the deceiver
key_terms.سِنِينَ خَدَّاعَةً: Deceitful years, a period of confusion and inverted values

ai.seo_question: What do the terms 'ruwaybida' and 'mahil' mean in the context of the signs preceding the appearance of the Mahdi?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam Ali (AS) characterizes the pre-appearance era as a time of epistemological crisis where truth and falsehood are inverted, a concept deeply rooted in Shia eschatology. The term 'ruwaybida' denotes a simpleton who speaks with authority, while 'mahil' refers to the master of deceit, illustrating how political and religious legitimacy are manipulated. This period is marked by the rise of unqualified voices in matters of faith, necessitating discernment among the faithful.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (26) Ahmed ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Taymili narrated to us from his book in Rajab of the year 277 AH. He said: Muhammad ibn 'Umar ibn Yazid, the seller of Sabrī (a type of cloth), and Muhammad ibn al-Walid ibn Khalid al-Khazzaz both narrated to us, saying: Hammad ibn Uthman narrated to us from Abdullah ibn Sinan. He said: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Abi Bilad narrated to me. He said: My father narrated to me from his father, from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata that he heard Imam Ali (as) say: "

Before the appearance of the Qa'im (Imam Al-Mahdi), there will be deceitful years in which the truthful will be called liars, and the liars will be believed, and those who deceive will be brought closer (and in another narration: the 'ruwaybida' will speak)."
So I asked: "What is the 'ruwaybida' and the 'mahil'?" He said: "Do you not read the Quran? It refers to deceit." I asked: "And what is the 'mahil'?" He said: "It refers to the deceiver."
